responsibility: This file implements the pre-register-allocation early rematerialization RTL pass. It identifies candidate pseudos in selected target modes for which spilling across calls is particularly undesirable, collects and value-numbers rematerializable defining insns, computes reaching definitions and candidate validity, chooses profitable rematerialization points locally and globally around calls, and emits cloned instruction sequences after calls or at block entries using target-selected modes. Its responsibility is an aggressive call-crossing rematerialization strategy for special register classes or scalable modes, distinct from ordinary reload-time spill/reload handling.
